body.zh-CN:
# 响应式与交互验收

逐项检查并记录结果。勾选仅表示当前浏览器中的个人进度，不代表真实 AI 效果验证。
body.en:
# Responsive and interaction acceptance

Inspect and record each result. Checked items represent local personal progress, not a verified AI outcome.

task.zh-CN: 按以下清单验收，并报告实际结果与未验证项。
task.en: Use the checklist below and report actual results and unverified items.

usage.zh-CN: 普通对话：复制本站整理的任务要求，并补充你的项目需求。编程助手：先提供项目上下文，再按文件说明使用；下载不会自动安装或执行。
usage.en: Chat: copy the Atlas task notes and add your project requirements. Coding assistant: provide project context, then follow the file instructions. Downloads do not install or execute anything.

zh-CN: 检查 375、768、1440 与 1910px，包含矮窗口及 110% 页面缩放。
使用键盘完成主要操作，确认焦点可见、顺序合理且弹层可关闭。
检查长文本、多语言、空数据、加载、成功和错误状态。
验证滚动区域、全屏退出和设备切换，保留输入与已有状态。
在实际运行环境观察控制台、请求与布局，不能仅凭构建通过宣称验收完成。
en: Check 375, 768, 1440 and 1910px, including short windows and 110% page zoom.
Complete primary actions by keyboard and verify visible focus, order and dismissible overlays.
Check long text, languages, empty data, loading, success and error states.
Verify scroll areas, fullscreen exit and device changes while retaining inputs and existing state.
Observe console, requests and layout in the running environment; a successful build alone is not acceptance.
